static_traits.name: Zhang Wei
static_traits.social_status: Avoids socializing与求职面试，缺乏可以讨论not安全感的亲友支持
static_traits.medical_history: 青少年时期即存在与身高相关的not安全感；not yet接受过心理咨询或心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 略显紧张（自述紧张）；表达清晰、能自我Reflection；合作度较好，愿意尝试记录与积极自我对话

basic_info.main_problem: 长期对自身身高感到not安全，认为总会因身高被他人评判、而得not到机会，这在求职面试与社交场合尤为突出，导致回避与Impaired self-esteem。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望获得心理支持，减轻因身高引发的not安全感与被评价的恐惧，提升求职面试中的自信与表现。
growth_experiences: 青少年时期在学校因身高被同伴取笑与忽视，由此形成并延续至今的自我not安全感；成年后在面试与社交场景中持续trigger该not安全感，导致回避行为与自尊受影响；此前not yet寻求过心理咨询与治疗。

core_beliefs: 我的身高决定了他人对我的评价与机会
No matter what I do, it is not good enough（身高会让他人negate我）

special_situations.event: 进入或即将进入求职面试现场
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果面试官第一眼看到我的身高，就会认定我not合适，拒绝我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避面试或以紧张、Self-doubt的状态参加；尝试用积极自我对话短暂提升信心但难以维持
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会一眼把我negate，not管我怎么准备都会Being rejected

special_situations.event: In the interview preparation stage or on site when needing to emphasize qualifications and abilities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要我的身高not占优势，我的表现再好也without济于事
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 难以专注于展示资历与能力，陷入Self-doubt；用Self-denialUndoingAnxiety

special_situations.event: When attending social or workplace networking events and first making contact with strangers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: do not人会把我的身高与能力直接挂钩，认为我not专业
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces participation in social and online activities to avoid being judged; gains comfort from being with the dog
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们肯定觉得我not够专业、能力not行

special_situations.event: 面试结束后not yet被录用的结果出现或被回忆时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not拿到工作，一定是因为我的身高
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将失败单一归因于身高，忽视其他可能解释，从而加剧回避与Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not拿到工作就是身高害的

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be fairly evaluated and accepted and to gain opportunities through ability
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因身高被羞辱与拒绝，担心自我价值被negate
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing与面试来降低被评判的风险、保护自尊

object_relations.self_representation: 被评判、易被negate的弱势求职者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻、挑剔、带有偏见的面试官/他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探问not yet被录用的原因或邀请其考虑其他可能解释时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将招聘决定理解为对自己身高的negate（把他人决定视为针对自己身体特征的评判）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气偏坚定，反复强调“主要是身高的原因”，弱化其他因素；use绝对化表述，少举具体证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor focuses on the feelings in social situations and others' views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人会看not起自己、觉得自己not专业（将内在的not安全感归于他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用确定性语言描述他人想法，如“他们肯定觉得我not行”；语气紧张、回避讨论反证。

manifestations: Lacks support from family and friends; mainly relies on a pet for emotional support
Avoids socializing与职场网络活动，难以建立有意义的人际连接

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others，与“拥有”对应，语言表现为：如“他在看not起我”“他们想排挤我”等。
manifestations: 在面试与社交场合中预设他人看not起自己、认为自己not专业
Negative interpretations of others' evaluations come first, ignoring facts and evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复Self-doubt，强调“I am not good enough”
Before and after interviews, overly cares about others' possible evaluations, affecting performance and action

positive_force: Self-described as diligent and responsible, willing to do tasks well (inner work ethic and persistence)
Willing to try recording and positive self-talk (open to change)
Able to consider other possible factors in hiring decisions (has some cognitive flexibility)
与宠物的情感连接可短暂缓冲压力与Loneliness感
negative_force: 过度在意他人评价并倾向负面解读（读心、预测not yet来）
Overgeneralizing and catastrophizing cognitive patterns, weaken evidence of one's own abilities
Avoids socializing与面试，减少真实表现与获取机会的可能
社会支持稀缺，缺乏可讨论not安全感的亲友网络
长期的被取笑经历固化了Self-denial与羞耻感

antecedent: 求职面试到来或进入面试现场
参加职场网络活动或陌生社交场合
target_behavior.core_reason: 青少年时期的身高被取笑经历Reinforcement了对他人评价的恐惧，形成对拒绝与羞辱的灾难化Anticipation与读心倾向
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的负面评价与拒绝，以保护自尊与降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 求职机会减少、社交联系受限、Interpersonal tension，自尊与Self-efficacy进一步下降

target_behavior.behavior: In interviews, excessive self-consciousness makes it hard to focus on presenting qualifications and abilities
antecedent: 需要突出自身经验与优势的环节
target_behavior.core_reason: 将他人注意力过度归因于身高，产生“without论怎么准备都not够好”的过度概括性信念
target_behavior.function: 通过自我贬低与防御性关注来试图降低被negate时的心理落差
target_behavior.consequence: 现场表现受损，难以有效呈现资历与优势，增加not yet录用的可能性并加深负性循环
